text: TERMINAL, refuted. Canonical membership identical across runs and equal to resolvePriorityControlPlanePartitionIds(). Canonical call order identical: control_plane_publications-p1, replica_operations-p1, schema_operations-p1, repeating, in every run. Call count identical at 51. The apparent permutation was a shifted READ sequence, not a reordered drive: comparing two AVAILABLE-read sequences of different lengths at index 0 aligned run 1 entry 0 against run 2 entry 2. Root cause belongs to unfinished prior-generation work, not ordering: a single simulation in a fresh process performs 49 AVAILABLE reads while it runs and two more land after simulate() has returned, and each later generation inherits the previous one's two late reads. No ordering owner is defective and no fourth ordering rule is needed. Superseded by formation-sim-rebalancer-current-work-completion.
